description: Compact oscillator with through-zero linear FM, a wavefolder and a VCA on its output, running as either a VCO or an LFO

params.text: Tunes the pitch, reaching 4 octaves either way on Full, 6 semitones on Octave, half a semitone on Semitone and 5 octaves either way on LFO
Picks how far FREQ reaches and whether the oscillator runs at audio rate or as an LFO: Full, Octave, Semitone or LFO
Folds the sine, triangle and sawtooth waves harder as it rises, and on the pulse wave sets the pulse width instead
Sets the base pitch in octave steps from C1 at 32.7Hz up to C7, and in LFO mode the same steps run from 0.125Hz to 8Hz
Picks the waveform at the output: sine, triangle, sawtooth or pulse

inputs.text: Linear frequency modulation that passes through zero, running the oscillator backwards on negative volts; its DC is filtered out by default
Adds to the TIMBRE slider, 0-10V covering its whole range
Volt-per-octave pitch, added to the FREQ knob and the OCT slider
A rising edge here restarts the waveform at the start of its cycle
Sets the output level, 0-10V from silence to full; with nothing patched the level is full

outputs.text: The chosen waveform, 10V peak to peak before the VCA

menu: Filter TZFM DC — takes the DC out of the signal arriving at the TZFM input; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
Oversampling — runs the oscillator above the sample rate to cut aliasing: Off, x2, x4 or x8, with x2 the default
Limit pulsewidth (5%-95%) — holds the pulse wave between 5% and 95% wide; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
Remove pulse DC — takes out the DC offset that an off-centre pulse width gives the pulse wave; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
